newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$8 billion funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$8 billion funds.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Tuesday injected T$8 billion worth of funds into the banking system through repurchase agreeements, a bank official said.

The bank, operating through finance companies authorised to issue commercial paper, bought T$8 billion in approved securities instruments offered by financial institutions with yield at between 7.00 and 7.25 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the instruments in seven days.
Earlier on Tuesday the central bank injected US$82 million, or approximately T$2.26 billion, worth of funds into the banking system through swap trading, banking sources said.
